blocks.title: Scope and reading guide
blocks.markdown: Order **Chinese Speaker (2659534)**, September 27–October 4, 2026, inclusive. October 4 is an in-progress date, so compare daily totals with care. Window totals and latest pacing posture have different grains. CTR is clicks divided by impressions; eCPM is spend per thousand impressions. Pacing-behind fields count lines behind, not a percentage or a causal diagnosis.

blocks.title: Daily trend interpretation
blocks.markdown: Use the daily spend series to locate a decline or recovery; an incomplete October 4 should not be compared with a complete day without matching elapsed hours. Pacing and shortfall alongside the trend indicate delivery posture, not its cause.

blocks.title: Bid funnel — submitted bids to impressions
Funnel coverage and interpretation
blocks.body: The visible bid funnel shows submitted bids and delivered impressions for the same order and window. The builder does not advertise allocated bid capacity or a bid-to-impression conversion field, so the capacity stage and conversion are not fabricated. Bids and impressions alone cannot prove whether eligibility, price, auction outcomes, or allocation caused a shortfall.

blocks.title: Reading the rankings
blocks.markdown: Each ranking uses one aggregate row per channel or country over the active report interval, not a mixed day-by-category slice. Compare spend scale with impressions, CTR and eCPM; a high-spend rank by itself does not establish the cause of underdelivery.

blocks.title: Findings
blocks.markdown: Use window spend, bids, impressions, CTR and eCPM as the delivery baseline. Check the daily chart for the first sustained change, then inspect which channel and country account for the most spend. Daily and flight shortfall and lines-behind indicators establish pacing posture, but the available report fields do not establish a root cause. Treat October 4 as provisional while the day is open.

blocks.title: Recommendations
blocks.body: **Now:** Preserve the current configuration while verifying whether the shortfall and daily trend persist across completed days. Review the highest-spend channel and country alongside their bids, impressions, CTR and eCPM before choosing a lever. **If the shortfall persists:** run a bounded delivery diagnosis for the same order and dates to distinguish allocation, targeting eligibility, price pressure, and post-bid outcomes before changing bids, budget, or targeting. **Do not** infer quota exhaustion or recommend a bid increase from these aggregate metrics alone.
